findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 41 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. The common bile duct is interrupted by the tumor, suggesting invasion. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the superior mesenteric vein, suggesting invasion. The tumor extends beyond the inferior border of the duodenum. Contact of more than 180° with both the celiac artery and the common hepatic artery is observed, suggesting invasion. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastasis is observed in one node at station 8p. No other metastases are observed.

responses.content:
Task 1: Diagnose the local invasion factors of pancreatic cancer.

CH1 (common bile duct invasion)
DU1 (duodenal invasion)
S1 (serosal invasion)
RP1 (retropancreatic tissue invasion)
PV1 (portal vein invasion, suggested by contact with the superior mesenteric vein)
A1 (celiac artery invasion)
PL0 (portal vein invasion, not specified, but PV1 is already assigned)
OO0 (no other local invasion factors identified)

Task 2: Determine the classification for local invasion (T classification) of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the size (41 mm) and extension-based criteria, the tumor is classified as T3.

Task 3: Determine the N classification of pancreatic cancer.

Regional lymph nodes for pancreatic cancer are defined as follows:
- Head: stations 8p, 8a, 8d, 9, 12a, 12b
- Body: stations 7, 8a, 8p, 9, 11, 12a, 12b
- Tail: stations 7, 8a, 11, 12a, 12b

The patient's metastatic lymph node station is 8p, which is regional for the head of the pancreas. Counting only the metastatic lymph node within the regional stations, the N classification is N1a.

Task 4: Determine the M classification of pancreatic cancer.

No distant metastases are observed, so the M classification is M0.

Task 5: Determine the resectability classification of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the results of Task 1 and Task 4, the tumor is resectable (R) because none of the criteria for Borderline Resectable (BR) or Unresectable (UR) are met.

Task 6: Determine the overall stage according to the JPS staging system.

Based on the determined T (T3), N (N1a), and M (M0) categories, the overall stage is Stage IIA.
